Right, quick tour and then I will leave you alone. Kitchen is open all day, so help yourself, you don't have to ask. There are bikes in the garage and you can take one whenever you want. Two things you have to do: the bins go out on Tuesday night, and you do your own laundry on Sunday. That is it, that is the whole list. You don't have to cook, we do that, although you can help if you feel like it. One thing you can't do: never leave the back door open, because the dog gets out and then we spend the evening looking for him. Your spare key is on the hook by the door.

Okay, so that was the official version. Here is the real one. The curfew on school nights is real, do not test it. But at the weekend nobody actually cares, as long as you send a message. The one rule you should never break is the bins. If you forget the bins, everybody is angry for a week and you will hear about it every single day. Also, mum says you don't have to cook, and that is true, but if you cook once she will talk about it for a month. Oh, and I have an old board in the shed. You can share it until your boards arrive.
